result: At the edge of stability the growing oscillation along the top eigenvector creates, through the third-order term of the loss, a drift that lowers the sharpness: self-stabilization. GD then tracks projected descent on the stable set {S ≤ 2/η}.
result_plain: Oscillation's cubic term pushes sharpness back below 2/η; GD follows projected descent on {S ≤ 2/η}.
